entities.summary: Hugh Richard Louis Grosvenor, 7th Duke of Westminster,, is a British aristocrat and inherited trust manager. He inherited his title and control of the Grosvenor Estate from his father in 2016, then worth an estimated £9 billion, making him one of the wealthiest men in Britain. In 2025, Bloomberg estimated that he had a net worth of approximately £9.56 billion. He ranked 14th on the Sunday Times Rich List 2025 with an estimated fortune of £9.884 billion in 2025.
